subject: Notice of resignation and medical accommodation request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-09T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Notice of resignation and medical accommodation request

Evelyn / Monica,

I'm writing to share that I need to resign from my role as Senior ML Engineer, with my intended last day being 2027-05-07. This decision is driven by an upcoming medical procedure that will require extended recovery time and relocation closer to family.

I want to make the transition as smooth as possible. I can commit to a staggered handoff: continuing part-time on high-priority bugs and running 3 KT sessions for the retrieval project before my last day, plus compiling runbooks and Jupyter snapshots.

I've attached a medical note to start the accommodation/leave paperwork.

Please let me know what information you need from me and how HR prefers to proceed (leave then resignation vs. immediate resignation). Happy to hop on a quick call.

Thanks for understanding,

Marissa Cole
Senior ML Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachment: marissa_med_note.jpg

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-09T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice of resignation and medical accommodation request

Marissa — thank you for letting us know and for the heads-up. I'm really sorry to hear you're going through this.

I appreciate the offer to run KT sessions and compile runbooks. Let's schedule a 30-minute sync today or tomorrow to map the highest‑risk handoffs and identify who will cover each area. Markus, can you confirm what access/equipment needs to be recovered and whether a phased hardware return is possible? Monica, please advise on leave vs resignation flow and what Marissa needs to submit. Karthik, tagging legal for any standard separation paperwork.

Drive: please put current notebooks + runbook draft in the shared folder (suggested path: Drive > Eng > Retrieval > Marissa-offboard). I'll set up the call and send calendar invites.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
VP, Engineering

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-09T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice of resignation and medical accommodation request — HR next steps

Hi Marissa, Evelyn —

Thanks for the note, Marissa, and I’m sorry to hear about the surgery. A few quick items from HR to help us triage: 

- If you intend to take medical leave before resigning, we can process FMLA/short-term disability paperwork; if you prefer to resign immediately, we’ll treat this as voluntary separation. Either way, please complete and return the attached leave intake form so we can confirm eligibility. (Attachment: leave_form.pdf)
- Please confirm your preferred last day and whether you want to remain on the team in a reduced capacity during recovery.
- Company assets: laptop (serial A12X), 2FA key, and any vendor devices. Markus, can you provide an inventory and recommend staggered return dates?
- Severance is not automatic for voluntary resignations, but given the health circumstances we can discuss a one‑time separation payment; Karthik/legal, please advise on standard language and timeline.

I've opened HR ticket HR-2047 and will coordinate benefits vendor intake and DocuSign if separation paperwork is needed. Marissa, once you confirm the path (leave then resign vs immediate resignation) we'll proceed.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Greenfield Benefits <engagement@greenfieldbens.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T14:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Benefits intake for Marissa Cole (HR-2047)

Hi Monica / Marissa,

We received HR-2047 and can start benefits continuation / COBRA / short-term disability intake as soon as we have: a completed leave_form.pdf, the medical certification (marissa_med_note.jpg), and the signed authorization for benefits release. Please upload the completed forms to the secure portal: https://portal.greenfieldbens.com/secure/redwood/HR-2047.

Estimated processing time is 5–7 business days after receipt. If Marissa is opting for leave first, short-term disability requires a physician's certification; if electing immediate resignation, please confirm termination date so we can calculate final benefits cutoff and COBRA notices.

Regards,
Lindsey Shaw
Client Success — Greenfield Benefits

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Draft separation terms for review / proposed phased handoff

Evelyn / Monica / Marissa —

I've attached a short draft separation agreement (Attachment: draft_sep_agreement.docx) that includes: a 60-day phased notice with pro‑rated separation payment (two installments: 50% on signing, 50% 30 days later), COBRA guidance, and a limited garden‑leave for customer contacts. It also includes a mutual non-disparagement clause and standard IP/return language. 

Given the medical circumstances, I'm proposing we treat this as an amicable separation with a modest separation payment to help bridge recovery — this avoids protracted negotiations for all sides and supports a planned knowledge transfer. If Marissa agrees to run the 3 KT sessions and maintain limited part‑time coverage for high-priority P0s during the 60-day window, we can proceed with the agreement as drafted.

Please review and flag any redlines by EOD Monday; Monica, once we have confirmation we'll prepare a DocuSign envelope (DocuSign-AB12).

—Karthik
Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T17:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft separation terms for review / proposed phased handoff

All — thank you. I appreciate the sensitivity here and am comfortable with the proposed approach. I can run the 3 KT sessions (recorded) and keep limited availability for P0 bug triage through 2027-05-07. I will upload the signed leave intake and medical certification to the Greenfield portal today.

Please let me know the calendar invite for KT sessions and any specifics you want included in the runbooks.

—Marissa
